title: Your First Weekend at Lehigh University, Shared as Cards
description: An under-21-safe Friday-to-Sunday sequence connecting Lehigh landmarks, student spaces, art, South Bethlehem trails, and industrial history.

cards.title: Start at Alumni Memorial
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival • Asa Packer Campus
cards.notes: Begin at the admissions landmark, photograph the memorial court, and use the campus tour route to orient yourself before heading uphill.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable starting point for learning the shape of Lehigh’s hillside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh identifies Alumni Memorial Building at 27 Memorial Drive West as the starting point for its Asa Packer Campus self-guided tour.
cards.access_notes: Campus terrain includes hills and steps; consult Lehigh’s accessibility and building-access information when planning the route.

cards.entity_name: Clayton University Center at Packer Hall
cards.title: Find Your Campus Crossroads
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Student-life orientation
cards.notes: Walk through the renovated center, locate its gathering and dining spaces, and choose an easy landmark for meeting new classmates later.
cards.short_summary: The restored university center provides an early reference point for meals, clubs, and informal meetups.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh states that the renovated Clayton University Center is open and includes dining, recreational, work, club, and gathering spaces.
cards.access_notes: Lehigh’s published building-access schedule lists weekend access; individual rooms or services may follow separate schedules.

cards.title: Learn the Library Landmark
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Academic bearings
cards.notes: Enter during posted hours, identify the service desk and accessible entrance, then note the route linking the library with the university center.
cards.short_summary: A practical first look at a central humanities library and one of campus’s most distinctive interiors.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh identifies Linderman Library at 30 Library Drive as a central-campus humanities library with Special Collections and full wheelchair access.
cards.access_notes: Check the library calendar before visiting. A Lehigh ID is required for entry after 9 p.m.; the accessible entrance is right of the main entrance.

cards.title: End Friday at Farrington Square
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • Optional ice-cream stop
cards.notes: Use Farrington Square as a gateway to South Bethlehem, and order only if you want a casual treat before returning to your residence hall.
cards.short_summary: A clearly marked campus-edge stop that helps connect Lehigh with the surrounding neighborhood.
cards.evidence_claim: Bethlehem Dairy Store lists The Cup at Lehigh at 2 Farrington Square and publishes Saturday and Sunday operating hours.
cards.access_notes: The business currently lists daily hours, including weekend hours; verify the direct location page before setting out.

cards.title: Walk the Official Campus Route
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • Self-paced orientation
cards.notes: Open Lehigh’s official audio tour, follow the named stops at your own pace, and pause whenever the hillside route becomes tiring.
cards.short_summary: A structured way to connect buildings seen separately during Friday’s arrival.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh publishes a self-guided walking tour of Asa Packer Campus covering academic, residential, dining, and student-life locations.
cards.access_notes: The route crosses a hilly campus. Use the browser-based audio guide and adapt the sequence to mobility needs, weather, and building access.

cards.entity_name: Lehigh University Art Galleries at Zoellner Arts Center
cards.title: Browse the Saturday Galleries
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday • Free campus art
cards.notes: Visit the main and lower galleries during posted Saturday hours, then use the free digital guide to identify works that catch your attention.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission campus museum stop with indoor galleries and an extensive outdoor sculpture collection.
cards.evidence_claim: LUAG lists galleries at Zoellner Arts Center, publishes Saturday hours, and describes its museum and guided or self-guided student visits as free.
cards.source_title: Explore Seven Galleries and Over 50 Outdoor Sculptures
cards.access_notes: The Zoellner galleries list Saturday hours and are normally closed Sunday and Monday; check the visit page for seasonal closures.

cards.title: Follow the Greenway West
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Neighborhood walk
cards.notes: Enter at a convenient Southside access point, walk a manageable segment, and look for public art and play areas noted by the city.
cards.short_summary: A paved linear route for seeing South Bethlehem beyond the immediate campus edge.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Bethlehem recommends the South Bethlehem Greenway for walking and identifies the Skateplaza, Arts District displays, and play areas along it.
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor linear park; choose a daylight segment suited to current weather and consult city notices for closures or trail conditions.

cards.title: Step Inside Industrial History
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Ticketed museum visit
cards.notes: Budget time for the indoor exhibits, compare student admission options, and focus on artifacts tied to Bethlehem’s manufacturing history.
cards.short_summary: A Smithsonian Affiliate housed in a former Bethlehem Steel repair shop near SteelStacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that it occupies the former Bethlehem Steel Electric Repair Shop, opens Wednesday through Sunday, and charges admission with a student rate.
cards.source_title: Visit — National Museum of Industrial History
cards.access_notes: The museum currently lists Wednesday–Sunday hours and ticket prices. Buy at the desk or online and check holiday closures before visiting.

cards.title: See the Steelworks from the Trestle
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • Elevated industrial walk
cards.notes: Walk the elevated linear park before closing, read the interpretation panels, and turn back early if weather conditions begin to change.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor vantage point for understanding the scale of the former Bethlehem Steel plant.
cards.evidence_claim: ArtsQuest publishes daily operating hours for the Hoover-Mason Trestle and warns that weather or special events can cause temporary closures.
cards.access_notes: Current regular hours extend through the evening, but the trestle may close for lightning, high winds, severe rain, or special events.

cards.title: Close the Weekend on South Mountain
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning • Outdoor reset
cards.notes: Choose a marked park route that fits your energy, carry water, and leave enough time to return to campus before Sunday commitments.
cards.short_summary: A nearby municipal park for a daylight walk after a campus-and-city weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Bethlehem lists South Mountain Park on Mountain Drive behind Lehigh University and identifies trails and disc golf there.
cards.access_notes: Visit in daylight, remain on established routes, check weather and city notices, and do not assume campus transportation serves the park.
